name: Otp
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; one-time-code flows recur across client repos, usually coupled directly to one SMS vendor)
description: One-time codes for passwordless sign-in and step-up verification. Ships an email channel; SMS is a contract a project binds, so no vendor is baked in. Rate limited, single use, hashed at rest, with an env-gated QA bypass.

login.label: Passwordless sign-in — request a code, get a token back

login+step-up.label: Both — sign-in codes AND re-verification before sensitive actions
